instruction: You are facing towards the bed, turn slight left and move towards the cupboard. Turn slight right and move forward. Now move towards the open door which is to your left. Turn left and move out of this room. Now move towards the pillar. You are facing towards the pool, turn right and move towards the open glass door. Turn right and move towards the sofa. Turn slight left and  move towards the open door. Turn slight left and move out of this house. Turn slight right and walk towards the last mat. Now you are standing on the last mat, which is your final destination.
